variants.headline: Home world sends punitive expedition
variants.body: The home world has sent a punitive expedition. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: An expedition with a punitive purpose
variants.body: A punitive expedition has been dispatched by the home world. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: Distant authority dispatches an expedition
variants.body: The home world has dispatched an expedition intended to punish the colony. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
